records.note: SIMULATED (model vs double-precision reference, and Icarus/Yosys runs of generated RTL/netlists; nothing is measured on silicon). Evidence record for decision 0006 (spec/decisions/0006-growth-schedule.md, Proposed): the recommended row (CONFIRM the placeholder, 1 bit/stage) and the runner-up ('half bit/stage'), each with model SQNR/overflow, the no-overflow amplitude range, the bit-exact RTL-vs-model check and klt synthesize figures. This record reports; 0006 argues; nothing is selected until the ruling. The runner-up's bit-exact check FAILED and its root cause is a generator defect filed as #162 - the failure is this record's finding, not a measurement gap.

model.matches_sweep_row: each set reproduces the 'placeholder (1 bit/stage)' row of measurements/schedule-sweep.json at 4 decimals

rtl_vs_model.check: verification/test_gen_exact.py with GEN_EXACT_PARAMS=rtl/params/fft256.candidate.params (make -C verification gen-exact), configuration (256, natural, pipeline=1)
rtl_vs_model.negative_control: GEN_EXACT_PERTURB=0 flips one captured LSB: run exits non-zero reporting '1 of 512 samples differ' at index 0, dut=(-653,208) model=(-654,208) - the comparison detects a single-bit mismatch
rtl_vs_model.rtl_identity: RTL generated from this file is byte-identical to the committed rtl/generated/ except the generated-by sha256 comment line in each emitted file (diff -r verified)

fresh_run.request: klt.synthesize.request/1: top fft256_stream, sources rtl/wrapper/fft256_stream.sv (unchanged) plus the six files generated from rtl/params/fft256.candidate.params, sky130_fd_sc_hd, tt_025C_1v80, clock unconstrained

synthesis.comparison: identical figures (same engine yosys 0.67+post): the recommended schedule's netlist is the committed netlist

runner_up.parameter_file_definition: rtl/params/fft256.params with the stage_widths line replaced by stage_widths=17,17,18,18,19,19,20,20 (twiddle_width unchanged at 16); not committed as a file - 0006 recommends against adopting it

model.matches_sweep_row: each set reproduces the 'half bit/stage' row of measurements/schedule-sweep.json at 4 decimals

overflow_range.method: sim.overflow_range.sweep on the parameter file above (same sweep rule as measurements/overflow-range.json; recorded here because the file is not committed)

rtl_vs_model.check: verification/test_gen_exact.py with GEN_EXACT_PARAMS=<runner-up file>, configuration (256, natural, pipeline=1)
rtl_vs_model.first_mismatch: index 0 (frame 0, bin 0): dut=(-10470,3329) model=(-654,208) - dut is the model scaled by 2^4
rtl_vs_model.root_cause: generator defect #162: rtl/gen emits no mid-pipeline width reduction, so each of the four equal-width transitions (17->17, 18->18, 19->19, 20->20) wraps the butterfly sum instead of dropping the growth LSB with convergent rounding as the model's _reduce specifies; divergence is exactly 2^(sum of drops) = 2^4
controls: placeholder widths through the same check path: PASS, 512/512 bit-exact (isolates the widths, not the check)
0002 reference point (17,18,18,19,19,20,20,21; three equal-width transitions): FAIL, dut = 8x model = 2^3, as predicted

synthesis.request: klt.synthesize.request/1: top fft256_stream, sources rtl/wrapper/fft256_stream.sv (unchanged) plus the six files generated from the runner-up parameter file, sky130_fd_sc_hd, tt_025C_1v80, clock unconstrained
synthesis.caveat: structural figures of the widths as currently emitted: they EXCLUDE the mid-pipeline convergent rounders the #162 fix must add before this schedule can be adopted, and include no timing claim (clock unconstrained)

records.area_proxy_note: summed stage width is a proxy, not an area figure: the runner-up cuts width_sum by 9.8% but measured synthesis saves 3.8% of cells, 2.3% of area and 1.4% of sequential area, because the reorder buffer, control and wrapper (unchanged by stage widths) hold most of the area. 0006 argues from the measured figures.

klt: 0.8.0 (signoff.yml pin; rtl/README.md notes synthesize flows need a newer klt than the 0.8.0 pin)

reproduce: make -C verification gen-exact PYTHON=<venv-python> GEN_EXACT_PARAMS=$PWD/rtl/params/fft256.candidate.params GEN_EXACT_PERTURB=0   # negative control: must fail with the mismatch text
make -C verification gen-exact PYTHON=<venv-python> GEN_EXACT_PARAMS=/tmp/runnerup.params   # must FAIL: generator defect #162
python3 -m rtl.gen rtl/params/fft256.candidate.params <scratch> && diff -r rtl/generated <scratch>   # sha comment line only
python3 -m rtl.gen <params> <scratch-rtl> && klt synthesize <request-with-those-sources> --format json   # request shape recorded above; both reports' figures recorded above
python3 -m sim.overflow_range rtl/params/fft256.candidate.params   # record 2 of measurements/overflow-range.json was appended from this run's numbers
